business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale International Distribution of Acetate Eyeglass Frames

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified continental commercial law with constitutional supremacy)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–Mexico Free Trade Agreement within the Pacific Alliance Framework
Colombia–Spain Bilateral Investment Agreement and Double Taxation Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creation of the UIAF); Ley 599 de 2000 (Código Penal, arts. 323 et seq. on money laundering); Ley 1121 de 2006; Ley 1762 de 2015; Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Decreto Único Reglamentario 1068 de 2015; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (commercial regulation); Resolución DIAN 000164 de 2021 and related UIAF regulations on final beneficiary reporting; Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Básica Jurídica on SAGRILAFT.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each subscribing shareholder and designated legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary or designated public authority in the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization if the country of origin is not party to the Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Company Register Extract of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or Chamber of Commerce of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization if the country of origin is not party to the Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / solvencia of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or other competent providential authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization if the country of origin is not party to the Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for company formation (poder especial) executed before a notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the foreign jurisdiction or Colombian Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization if the country of origin is not party to the Apostille Convention

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic screening standards: identify and verify all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and final beneficial owners holding directly or indirectly 25% or more of the S.A.S. against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated List, Colombian Procuraduría disqualification lists, contraloría records, and UIAF financial intelligence indicators; perform positive identification with passport or official ID, screen against sanctions lists before name reservation, document results in a sealed AML/KYC file, and establish an ongoing SAGRILAFT/SARLAFT monitoring protocol.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) via the competent Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company denomination must be composed in Spanish or in a Latin-script form accepted for uniform indexing in the RUES; if a foreign-language name is desired, a Spanish transliteration or explanatory Spanish translation must be included in the articles of incorporation; the legal form suffix 'S.A.S.' must appear at the end of the denomination; initials, numerals, and distinctive signs may be used only if they do not create identity with an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may (1) submit a corrected alternative denomination for a new homonymy search; (2) file a 'recurso de reposición' within ten business days before the same Chamber of Commerce that issued the rejection, attaching evidence of prior authorized use or legal authorization for any sensitive token; (3) file a 'recurso de apelación' in the subsidiary form before the Superintendencia de Sociedades if the reconsideration is denied; and (4) after exhausting administrative remedies, initiate the contentious-administrative lawsuit before the competent Administrative Tribunal. The reservation window may be renewed or extended only where the Chamber's internal tariff and CF procedures expressly permit an additional term without lapsing priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office/coworking addresses are conditionally acceptable as the statutory registered office and tax domicile of a wholesale ophthalmic eyewear distribution S.A.S., provided the address is a real, physical Colombian address accepted by the Chamber of Commerce and DIAN for service of notices and tax registration; a virtual office is not sufficient for customs warehouse authorization or inventory storage, and the company must keep its principal place of business, books, and substance consistent with the declared wholesale activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 10% or less in the first year for a low-risk administrative-only S.A.S.; the probability rises to 25–35% if customs filings, DIAN registrations, or documentary substance indicate high-volume physical distribution without corresponding inventory and operational presence.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation AML/CFT and sanctions background screening of proposed shareholders, directors, and UBOs against PEP, OFAC, UN, and Colombian lists
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local compliance counsel / external AML service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee per corporate group

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homonymy certificate (certificado de homonimia) at the competent Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory Chamber of Commerce tariff for name search and certificate issuance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille/consular legalization of foreign shareholder documents (passport, certificate of incorporation, good standing, power of attorney) — estimated per shareholder bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign notary and apostille issuing authority / Colombian Consulate where applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per document plus statutory apostille or consular fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. articles of incorporation, Spanish-language bylaws, shareholder register book, UBO disclosure annex, and AML/CFT recitals
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for standard S.A.S. formation package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial authorization, submission of incorporation documents, legalization of books, and registration in the RUES commercial registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public and Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff and Chamber of Commerce registration fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN / UIAF and local compliance officer or attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory nil filing fee plus market cost for compliance implementation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office / virtual address service for the S.A.S. statutory domicile and DIAN correspondence (twelve months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial office provider or coworking operator in Colombia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for virtual office and registered agent service

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), as amended; Código de Comercio Articles 98-110 and 137; Ley 1429 de 2010 (employment-driven company formalization); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (Decreto Único Reglamentario de Comercio, Industry and Tourism)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (Registro Único Empresarial – RUES), under the functional supervision of Superintendencia de Sociedades; tax registration before DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) filed for enrollment in the Libro I – Registro Mercantil; a Notarial Public Deed (Escritura Pública) is mandatory only if real property is contributed as paid-in capital
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a S.A.S.; the subscribed capital must be fully subscribed and paid within two (2) years from incorporation; no escrow account requirement – contributed cash is freely held in the company's commercial bank account
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S.

The founding shareholder, having subscribed the entire share capital, hereby resolves:

1. Share Subscription: The subscribed capital set forth in the bylaws is confirmed and assumed.
2. Registered Office: The registered office is fixed at [Address], [City], Colombia, within the jurisdiction of the corresponding Cámara de Comercio.
3. Officers: [Name] is appointed Legal Representative and [Name] Alternate Legal Representative, each for four years.
4. Authorizations: The Legal Representative is authorized to register the company before the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, and banks.
5. Capital Payments: Contributions may be paid within two years from incorporation per Article 5, Law 1258 of 2008.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Certification (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de [City] – RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co) or in-person customer service window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names through the RUES virtual system or at the Chamber of Commerce window. The system verifies that the requested denomination does not coincide with any existing corporate name or registered trademark and issues a certificate of non-coincidence valid for 60 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate names (maximum three)
Applicant's national ID or passport
Power of attorney if filed through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is rejected due to similarity, immediately file a new request with alternative names or submit a formal clearance petition to Superintendencia de Sociedades for a binding criterion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría (Notary Public) within the city of the registered office; optional for private documents, mandatory if real estate is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation instrument in Spanish per Law 1258/2008, covering bylaws, subscriber identification, subscribed capital, business purpose, governance rules, and legal representation. Execute the document with notarized signatures where the bank or the Chamber of Commerce requires it. The instrument must state the corporate term, the registered office, and the payment term of contributions.
required_dossiers: Pre-validated name certificate issued in Step 1
Subscribers' citizenship cards or passports
Full Spanish bylaws text with ISIC 4646 scope
Registered office address proof (lease or free-use title)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any defect by executing a corrective amendment document under Article 9 of Decreto 2150 de 1995 and re-submit for notarial protocolization before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Mercantile Registry and Issuance of Certificate of Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, Medellín, or Cali)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument together with the RUES application form to the Chamber of Commerce. The registrar qualifies the document, collects the registration and matrícula mercantil fees, and issues the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal). Registration is completed on the same day in most cases.
required_dossiers: Signed Documento Privado de Constitución
RUES registration form signed by the legal representative
Certificate of homonymy (name availability)
Identity documents of all officers
Proof of payment of registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar raises a query, file a written clarification (aclaración) within ten business days, pay any supplementary fee, or escalate to Superintendencia de Sociedades for a formal ruling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration and NIT Assignment through DIAN (Registro Único Tributario – RUT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (online at www.dian.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the RUT registration linked to the Certificate of Existence issued by the Chamber of Commerce. Select the applicable tax regimes: income tax (responsable), VAT (IVA) for wholesale sales, and the electronic invoicing obligation. The legal representative must authenticate the form using a valid digital certificate; the system assigns the NIT upon completion.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (not older than 90 days)
RUT online form signed by the legal representative
Legal representative's identity document and e-mail
Proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For online rejection, correct data inconsistencies and resubmit via the RUT update module or schedule an in-person appointment at a DIAN office for manual validation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Capital Contribution Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank supervised by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA) or a regulated payment platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking or savings account presenting the incorporation file. Deposit the subscribed cash capital under the company's name and record the deposit in the bank's account opening documentation. In-kind capital contributions are formalized in the bylaws and verified through the entry ledger. Foreign-owned S.A.S. entities must ensure the account supports Swift_TT and Platform_Pay payment rails for the wholesale optical frames trade.
required_dossiers: NIT and RUT certificate issued by DIAN
Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Board resolution appointing authorized signatories
Identity documents of authorized representatives
Economic activity declaration (ISIC 4646 – wholesale distribution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires enhanced due diligence for non-resident shareholders, submit source-of-funds documentation and certified ID copies, or apply to an alternate regulated financial institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance, Electronic Invoicing and Labor/Risk Formalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (electronic invoicing), ARL (Riesgos Laborales administrator), and Cámara de Comercio (books enrollment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enable electronic invoicing within the RUT, enroll the legal representative and any employees with an ARL under the Sistema General de Riesgos Laborales, and register the corporate books (libros de actas, registro de accionistas, and fiscal books) with the Chamber of Commerce. If non-resident shareholders exist, submit the foreign direct investment registration to Banco de la República within 12 months of the capital contribution.
required_dossiers: RUT printed with electronic invoicing authorization
ARL worker registration form
Minutes book and shareholder register for enrollment
Foreign investment declaration form for Banco de la República (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Attend DIAN support sessions to correct RUT data or file an appeal (recurso de reconsideración) against any administrative decision within the statutory deadlines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – the activity is wholesale commercial distribution of acetate eyeglass frames (ISIC 4646 / NAICS 423460), not manufacturing; INVIMA health registry is not required because optical frames without prescription lenses or medical-device claims fall outside the scope of medical device regulation.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating or manufacturing license required; generic municipal commercial operating permit under Ley 1801 de 2016 (Código Nacional de Seguridad y Convivencia Ciudadana) and location permit under Ley 232 de 1995 are the only operative mandates.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA – Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (national) / CAR – Corporación Autónoma Regional (regional, depending on warehouse location)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – commercial warehousing and wholesale distribution without industrial transformation; no Category I-III project under Decreto 1076 de 2015, so no prior environmental license or automatic environmental registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial effluents or VOC emission thresholds are triggered; only general municipal solid waste management rules and Resolution 1407 de 2018 obligations for the management of imported packaging apply if goods are repacked; no wastewater discharge permits required for office/warehouse uses.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Certificado de Bomberos) for the warehouse and office premises; structural load inspection for storage racks holding acetate frame cartons; occupational workplace clearance through ARL enrollment; basic sanitation verification by the municipal health authority for the commercial warehouse.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — the unitary national tax and customs administration (organic rules under Decree 1742 of 2020); primary official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co. MUISCA is the tax-administration platform for NIT/RUT registrations and filings; SFE (Sistema de Facturación Electrónica) web-services operate the mandatory e-invoicing validation; VUCE and the SIGCE/SOF-customs modules handle export customs formalities. Banco de la República exercises complementary foreign-exchange supervision through authorized local intermediaries (intermediarios del mercado cambiario).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The CO_SAS must complete the following sequence: (1) Incorporate the S.A.S. before a Colombian notary and register with the Cámara de Comercio (CCB/RUES) to obtain the provisional NIT; (2) file the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) electronically through MUISCA or at a DIAN servicio de atención, attaching the certificate of existence and legal representation (certificado de existencia y representación legal), notarized bylaws, the legal representative's national ID or foreign passport, and the final-beneficial-owner declaration of the non-resident shareholders; (3) receive the definitive NIT and RUT, which automatically designates the SAS as income-tax declarant ('Declarante de Renta'), 'Responsable del IVA — Régimen Común', withholding agent (agente de retención), electronic-invoice issuer, and customs exporter-importer; (4) obtain the DIAN-accredited digital signature (firma electrónica / DAS) to authenticate e-invoices and MUISCA procedures; (5) register any incoming foreign investment with Banco de la República and open the 'Declaración de Cambio' file with a local commercial bank, through which future export receivables must be repatriated; (6) complete SFE technical onboarding for XML/CUDS/QR issuance, either via a DIAN-authorized technology provider (proveedor tecnológico) or through the free DIAN web portal. The whole NIT/RUT activation process takes approximately 1–3 business days after RUES registration and is valid for all national tax, customs, and municipal obligations without a separate sub-jurisdictional tax registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the S.A.S. (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada) is a resident legal entity subject to Colombian corporate income tax on its worldwide income at the statutory headline CIT rate in force (régimen ordinario); profits are not attributable to shareholders for Colombian tax purposes, no pass-through or flow-through election is available; distributions of taxed profits to non-resident shareholders trigger final dividend withholding tax at the statutory rate applicable to foreign beneficiaries; the entity is not a free-trade-zone taxpayer unless it obtains a separate 'Usuario de Zona Franca' authorization, and it therefore operates under the general territorial tax regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no US-style check-the-box system and the SAS cannot elect transparent status. The statutory elections available are: (i) the optional integrated 'Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE)', a turnover-based consolidated payment replacing income tax, national consumption tax (where applicable) and ICA, available to an SAS only if the preceding-year gross revenue does not exceed 100,000 UVT, all shareholders are natural persons, and economic-substance/client tests (including domestic-recipient concentration) are met; (ii) consolidated income-tax filing ('régimen de consolidación fiscal') where a Colombian controlling entity holds 100% of the SAS and obtains DIAN authorization; (iii) formal VAT zero-rating treatment for exports and export-related services, with the corresponding bimestral input-VAT refund claim (devolución) under Art. 855 ET; (iv) transfer-pricing documentation elections such as the six-month post-filing deadline for the master/local files and the possibility of submitting mutual agreement or advance-pricing requests through DIAN's APA regime; and (v) hybrid-mismatch containment — no standalone hybrid-instrument election exists, but Colombia restricts deductibility of payments to zero-tax or non-cooperating jurisdictions under Articles 406-1, 124-1 and 140-3 ET and applies OECD-oriented CFC and minimum-top-up rules introduced by Law 2277 of 2022, so the SAS must disclose such payments in information returns attached to its annual CIT filing.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA — Colombian VAT), governed by Articles 420 to 508 of the Estatuto Tributario (Law 2010 of 2019 and subsequent amendments); complementary municipal Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA) and, where incidental sales to Colombian final consumers of specified goods occur, the Impuesto Nacional al Consumo (INC).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no economic turnover threshold exempting legal persons from Colombian VAT. An SAS is mandatorily classified as 'Responsable del IVA del Régimen Común' from its first taxable operation (sale, rendering, or import in Colombian territory), regardless of revenue level, and must be registered in the RUT and issue e-invoices from that first operation. The only statutory de minimis category is the 'Régimen Simplificado', reserved for natural persons with gross revenue not exceeding the annual simplified-regime ceiling (approximately 3,500 UVT); it is not available to SAS legal entities. Separately, ICA and INC apply only where the local-clearance rules of each municipality or the specific goods trigger them; the export sales of eyewear frames remain outside ICA, which respects territoriality rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: E-invoicing is mandatory. From the first invoice, the SAS must issue the Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) in DIAN-defined XML (technical annexes under Resolución 000012 de 2021 and updates), transmit each document in near-real time for validation through DIAN SFE web-services or an authorized technology operator, embed the CUDS (Código Único de Documento Soporte) and QR code, and ensure the purchaser accepts or rejects the electronic document within 48 hours. Export transactions must be documented with the FEV-export variant accompanied by the DEX; import purchases (e.g., acetate sheet inputs) are evidenced through the 'Documento Soporte en Adquisiciones a Proveedores del Exterior'. The SAS must maintain the electronic issuance log, and if it ever makes retail B2C sales in Colombia, DIAN-certified POS equipment (máquinas registradoras POS) with direct fiscal transmission is additionally required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export sales of tangible goods — including acetate ophthalmic eyeglass frames (HS 9004.11 / 9004.19) — are 'ventas exentas' (0% VAT) under Article 481 ET and Decree 1165 of 2019 when the following cumulative criteria are met: (i) the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory under a DEX accepted by DIAN (with Incoterms FOB, CIF, EXW or autre shipping evidence showing the consignment destined abroad); (ii) ownership and risk pass to a buyer domiciled outside Colombia; (iii) the price is actually paid by, and collected from, the foreign buyer; and (iv) the exporter proves the shipment by a bill of lading/air waybill and, where applicable, an FX-compensation certificate. Cross-border services (including nearshore software development and digital services) are similarly zero-rated where the recipient is domiciled abroad, the service is effectively used outside Colombia, and payment comes from abroad; the exporter retains the right to refund (devolución/compensación) of input VAT embedded in export costs on bimestral returns.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación — DEX) formalized in MUISCA/SIGCE-SOF, containing the assigned export registration number, tariff classification, invoice value, and the authorized 'autorización de embarque'
Bill of Lading (master and house) or Air Waybill evidencing the physical departure of the acetate frame consignment from Colombian customs territory to the foreign port/airport of destination

Inward Remittance Certificate — the 'comprobante de ingreso de divisas' or 'declaración de cambio' issued by the Colombian authorized FX intermediary, evidencing that the export proceeds were received, converted and settled in Colombia within the mandatory repatriation window
FEV export e-invoice with CUDS/QR, commercial invoice, packing list, and weight certificate for the specific consignment

Certificate of origin or preferential-origin evidence (where the buyer claims tariff benefits, e.g., US-Colombia TPA, EU FTA, or Andean Community origin) and, for medical-grade optical products, the technical file establishing country of origin
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN and Banco de la République exercise layered audit scrutiny over export zero-rating and refund claims. Where the DEX/divisas/transport documentation is missing, inconsistent, or found to be simulated, the export is recharacterized as a domestic taxable sale and the 19% IVA becomes payable, with daily moratory interest, plus: (i) the 'sanción por inexactitud' under Article 648 ET, generally 100% of the higher tax or over-refund, rising to 200% where the inexactness arises from an abusive tax arrangement; (ii) penalties for non-compliance and customs infractions under Articles 641–647 ET and Law 1762 of 2015, including seizure and foreclosure measures on the exported goods and detention of the responsible legal representative; (iii) criminal liability for fraudulent refund claims and customs falsity under the tax-fraud and contraband provisions of Law 2277 of 2022 and the Código Penal, carrying prison terms and fines; and (iv) canceling or suspension of the RUT export marker and exclusion from the e-invoicing scheme, with automatic inclusion in DIAN's risk lists for subsequent consignments. The exporter bears the evidential burden at every audit stage; the refund is suspended until the documentary bundle is certified.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Banrep) in conjunction with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism. Foreign exchange operations and capital movements are governed by the Colombian Foreign Exchange Regime (Régimen Cambiario) as codified in Statute of Foreign Exchange and related 'Resoluciones' and the Single Regulatory Circular DCIN-83 issued by Banrep.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible for current account transactions (trade in goods and services, royalties, dividends on registered investment, and ordinary remittances). Capital account transactions, including inbound foreign direct investment (FDI) and cross-border loans, require prior registration with Banrep under the Resolution 1 of 2018 and must be channelled through authorized foreign exchange market intermediaries (Mercado Cambiario). Profit remittance to a foreign shareholder is permissible from the second fiscal year onwards under an officially registered foreign investment; the remittance must be documented with audited financial statements, a Board or Shareholders' resolution authorizing dividends, and proof of tax clearance from DIAN (Paz y Salvo). Without an active foreign investment registration (Form 4), the remittance will be treated as non-resident remittance subject to higher withholding and possible rejection by domestic banks due to regulatory non-compliance. For an S.A.S. wholly owned by non-residents, capital account conversion restrictions are administratively onerous but not prohibitive; delays typically arise from missing prior-year registration filings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export proceeds for goods such as ophthalmic eyewear frames must be repatriated into Colombia and are required to be collected within the statutory collection term established by the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República, generally 9 months from the date of shipment under the current Circular, statutorily extendable up to an additional 3 months for exceptional circumstances (e.g., documentary collection delays, customs verification). Exporters are required to enter into the 'channeling' process through a bank on the list of authorized foreign exchange intermediaries; the proceeds must be credited to a local account in COP or foreign currency and reported to the Central Bank via the 'forma número 1' (Declaración de Operaciones de Exportaciones). There is no mandatory percentage conversion to COP if the foreign currency account is in an authorized Colombian financial institution, but all proceeds must either be converted and deposited in COP or remain in a legal foreign currency account that is part of the Colombian Foreign Exchange Market. Failure to meet the collection term may trigger a 'cede' (restriction) on the exporter's FI access, withholding on future export transactions, and an immediate obligation to sell the unrelated foreign currency in the local market.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules_addition: Because the company is a wholesale distributor purchasing frames from foreign suppliers and reselling internationally, the legal regime requires that any export of Colombian-origin goods be declared with DIAN Form 150 (Export Registration) and the foreign currency proceeds must be repatriated using the same border customs registration number assigned by the National Tax and Customs Directorate (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales - DIAN).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Subcuenta de Inversión Extranjera) / Operational Account
Operational Account only (foreign currency account add-on available)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: MEDIUM-LOW for corporate banking, but acceptable as auxiliary multi-cadence currency pooling in specific corridors (e.g. US/Europe) without domestic Colombian settlement. Offshore digital EMI wallets (such as Wise Business, Airwallex, or Payoneer) are not permitted to host the main treasury account because under the Colombian regulatory organic law the company must maintain its principal treasury and receivable settlement account with a Colombian credit institution that is a member of the Cámara de Riesgo Central de Contraparte and supervised by the SFC for money-laundering and foreign-exchange compliance. An offshore EMI may be used as an overflow dedollarization bucket only if it operates under a valid license in a white-listed jurisdiction (e.g., FCA in the United Kingdom or FinCEN/State license in the United States) but it cannot be used to receive foreign finance from the parent company without violating Colombian capital market channeling rules. The legal workaround is to use the EMI for paying non-colombian suppliers in trade amounts lower than USD 5,000 each, provided each transaction is reported under the periodic 'Exportaciones' data filing to Banrep.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of all directors is not mandatory for a whitelisted S.A.S. whose main purpose is international wholesale. Colombian banks require that the legal representative (natural person) and at least one of the members holding at least 10% of the shares complete a remote identity verification using biometric screening (Facial Recognition + Validated ID) and incorporate the notarized corporate existence certificate (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) issued by the local Chamber of Commerce no more than 30 days prior to opening the account. A physical or videoconferencing board meeting is generally required when the legal representative is a non-resident alien, but in practice banks allow a one-time videoconference interview conducted in Spanish or English from the company's headquarters, provided the bank issues a 'due diligence waiver' for the non-residential entity. For the Capital Escrow Account, an additional physical visit by the appointed local Compliance Officer is required to satisfy the 'anticipated contact' requirement; if no physical visit is possible, the bank may hire the international AML/KYC verification service of a Notary Public in Colombia with Apostille to certify the identity appearance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner global complexity (non-resident shareholders and intermediate holdings)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the full 22-column Beneficial Ownership Register ('Registro Final de Beneficiarios') mandated under SFC Circular 032 of 2021, showing each natural person above 25% equity; consolidate a Swiss-style Equity Holding Chart; obtain the sworn statement of the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declared before a Colombian notary; include audited financials of intermediate holding 10 days prior to account opening; and prepare a 'waterhead' explanation for any shell-flagging in the ownership structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Geographical risk: supplier or customer base includes names appearing in the OFAC and/or Colombian MACMA / SFC lists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare a completed Sanctions Radar questionnaire showing 0% exact hits in OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and Colombia's Consejo Nacional de Política Criminal (CONPES). Attach an Enterprise-wide AML policy, notarized wording that the company does not transact with North Korea, Iran, Syria, Sudan, Cuba or Venezuela (legal prohibition), and provide the invoice trail for the top 10 buyers mapping to unsanctioned banking jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicious export proceeds pattern (mounting, immediate outward transfer, 'round-tripping' suspicion)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: For all international trade movements exceeding USD 50,000, produce the underlying sales contract, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, and the customs declaration (DIAN Form 150). If using a foreign parent corporate treasury as clearing hub, provide the intercompany treasury and settlement agreement with transfer pricing report demonstrating an arm's length margin (the LLC: TNMM method with 8-10% operating margin), and produce attestation from the Colombian external auditor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign-policy obstacles: non-resident legal representative without Tax Identification Number in Colombia
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Before account opening, the legal representative must obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) assigned by DIAN, a power of attorney registered with the Notary in Colombia (or a Colombian Consulate for jurisdictions with consular rights), and the original passport with biometric chip. The mandatory evidence is the 'Certificado de Inscripción en Camara de Comercio' (Cámara y Comercio) including the representative's ID, and the 'Formulario del Registro Personas Expuestas Políticamente (PEP)'.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital escrow account destination mismatch (using escrow account to send operational payments to third parties)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Demonstrate that the capital escrow operational ledger is only used for the formal transfer of foreign investment into the Colombian entity, plus the subsequent payment of trade creditors, not for remuneration to directors. Provide the Equity Payment Plan (Plan de Inversión) approved by the shareholders; explain that after receipt of funds, the escrow account will be immediately converted into a regular operational account within 10 banking days (a standard 'account reclassification'), and show the closing balance reconciliation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The only compliant route for an inbound capital injection to the Colombian S.A.S. from its foreign shareholder(s) is (i) register the foreign investment with Banrep under the Foreign Investment Regulation (Resolución 1 of 2018 / Banco de la República 'Registro de Inversiones Internacionales'), filing Form 3 (Registration of Foreign Investment) and obtaining a single national 'CUTE' (Código de Registro de Protección de Inversiones) or a local 'Formulario de Inversión Extranjera'; (ii) open a 'Capital Escrow Account' (Subcuenta de Inversión Extranjera) at a tier-1 Colombian bank under the Bank's settlement hub; (iii) instruct the sending bank to use the SWIFT MT103 message format with the foreign exchange purpose code 'INV.FD.101' (Investment in capital of financial or non-financial entities) or, where applicable, 'INV.DS.103' (public debt / portfolio investment). Wire transfer to the escrow account must include the CUTE registration number in the beneficiary reference field, the legal entity tax ID (NIT) of the Colombian company, and the seal 'REGI' (inversion registrada). After the amounts are received, within 5 banking days the bank must be instructed to convert the received foreign currency into COP at the current intraday market rate if the company wants to avoid maintaining a restricted foreign currency account. The bank will automatically issue the 'Formas de Cambio' (Formulario de Operaciones Cambiarias) to Banrep on the same business day. The injection must be accompanied by Board resolutions approving the capital increase, the modified Bylaws of the S.A.S. stamped by the Chamber of Commerce, and for amounts above USD 250,000, a proof of source of funds issued by a solidarity financial institution of the home country (Apostillised), plus the Colombian bank's 'FIM' (Formulario de Información Monetaria) due diligence documents.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border payments to nonresident optical frame manufacturers (e.g., acetate material vendors in Italy, China, Hong Kong, or Korea) must be channelled through the authorized FX market via one of the following clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for regular commercial transfers using purpose codes 'CURRENT ACCOUNT: 727 - Imports of Goods' (Pago de Importaciones). For settlements below USD 10,000, the bank requires only the supplier's proforma invoice; for settlements above USD 10,000, submit the customs import declaration (Form 150 BI) after real entry into Colombia, the contract, and the previously approved 'Registro de Compras' (Purchase Register) as required by Banrep Circular DCIN-83. Alternatively, (ii) Commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) with standard ICC UCP600 rules may be used for bulk purchases of acetate frames from overseas, opened at the Colombian bank (issuing bank) in favor of the exporter; the confirmed L/C clearing rail is executed in the same FX channel, under purpose code '727 - Importaciones', and must be confirmed under the bank's 'Cámara de Compensación Internacional' or their Nostro/VOSTRO network (USD, EUR, CNY). All outbound disbursements to repeat supply partners should be made after CADES (Centro de mencatiación) record date to ensure the authority to transfer the funds enters in the tradable cycle. The treasury should also use 'BDPROW' platform (Banca de Pagos y Recaudo de Operaciones de Comercio Exterior) for real-time payment status reconciliation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Colombian peso - foreign currency systematic forwards (FX Forwards) with an authorized local bank, quoted as the NTRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado) rate at the transaction date. A final value dated OC/IN (Overseas Collection / Intercompany Netting) may be used for hedging the peso payables on the trade cycle.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only if the transaction is interbank and both counterparties are resident financial institutions registered with the SFC; the NDF can reference the Colombian peso without physical settlement in COP, but the settlement must be in USD through an offshore account. This instrument is permitted only to hedge commodity or trade exposure and not for speculative positions.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) when the volume of monthly trade disbursements exceeds US$500,000 and the contractual maturity is more than 12 months; permitted only with an authorized Colombian bank or an international bank that holds a license from the SFC to operate in the local market. All swaps must be recorded in the Banco de la República 'Registro de Derivados' on the same day of execution.

Currency options (call/put USD-COP) classified as excluding speculative variance, provided they are functionally hedges for identified FX risk arising from export/import flows; with the principle that the bank must verify the underlying transaction and include a clause automatically exercising the option if the transaction does not mature (clause of 'eliminación de utilidad especulativa').
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.additional_rail_note: For recurring cross-border small-value payments (e.g., payments for regulatory trademark renewals, online platform subscription for ophthalmic inventory management), the 'Platform_Pay' rail is allowed via a Colombian market platform integrated with an authorized payment institute (Sistema de Pagos de Bajo Valor) but must not exceed 20,000 SMLMV (monthly minimum wage) per operation and must be registered for AML monitoring. High-value international wires to third parties in currencies other than USD (e.g., EUR to Italian frame suppliers) should be diverted through the bank's global FX desk to the ECB Target2 clearing infrastructure; all outgoing invoices must include the company's NIT and the importer's EIN / VAT ID, ensuring the proper attributable tax base for the 15% withholding on payments abroad.

mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva, if applicable)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de la Asamblea General)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Law 2277 of 2022; effective for taxable years 2022 onwards; no municipal or regional corporate income surcharge for a trading SAS)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general sectoral exemption for wholesalers of optical frames. Available limited incentives: 100% deduction plus 25% tax discount on investments in research, technological development and innovation (unused discount nontransferable); dividend income received by the SAS is generally not creditable. Export income is taxable; no export CIT exemption unless granted under free-zone regime (not assumed herein).
